in_hebrew.name: Gillian
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Hill of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gillian הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Γιλλιάν (Gillian), which means 'hill of God'. This name is often associated with the biblical figure Gillian, a descendant of King David in the Old Testament.

in_latin.name: Gillian
